create_sin_embedding: create a 1D sinusoidal positional embedding tensor for a given sequence length and model dimension
create_2d_sin_embedding: create a 2D sinusoidal positional encoding tensor for height and width spatial dimensions
create_sin_embedding_cape: create a CAPE positional embedding with optional mean normalization and random augmentation for training
build_CrossTransformerEncoder: build a CrossTransformerEncoder module with alternating self-attention and cross-attention layers for spectrogram and temporal features
build_MultiheadAttention: build a custom MultiheadAttention module with optional dynamic sparse attention support via xformers
